title: Unprotected main branch before GitHub governance remediation

spec.observations: Read-only GitHub observations before remediation: main reported protected=false and required checks off; ruleset and effective branch-rule responses were empty. The validate check from GitHub Actions succeeded at the subject revision but was not required. The authenticated observer krnese_microsoft had pull-only repository permissions. Legacy protection returned 404, which is not independent proof of absence; Actions permissions returned 403. Administrative settings, retention and merge-blocking behavior remain unverified. No GitHub configuration or resources were changed. Failure describes the missing governance controls, not a failed baseline capture. The capture identifies the pre-edit source revision and external observation window, not a test of subsequently added files. This evidence file and its observation are prepared for Git review; independent retrieval requires committing/publishing them through separately authorized review.
